title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with incredible sound captures a high‑energy late‑summer ’82 show featuring rocking Bertha>Promised Land and tight transitions throughout the set.
ai_review.review: The tape, likely a matrix mix, is praised for its crystal‑clear overall sound, making every instrument shine. Reviewers highlight a vibrant first set of twelve songs with standout segues like Bertha into Promised Land and Candyman into Cold Rain & Snow, indicating a high‑energy performance that exemplifies the band's late‑summer 1982 tour.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive comments on both show energy and recording clarity, but limited detail and a single ambiguous star rating keep confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall sound described as incredible; clear mix with good instrument separation and no reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

standout_songs: Dupree's Diamond Blues > Used to Love Her
show_quality.setlist_flow: Twelve‑song first set with smooth segues and strong momentum; reviewers note the set “rockin out of the gate.”
